domainSpecifier: Hybrid boutique fitness and wellness studio
oneLineDescription: Open Stand is a hybrid boutique fitness and wellness studio offering barre and pilates classes, IV vitamin drips, an infrared sauna, and a low-key cafe.

services.name: Barre and Pilates classes
services.description: Group fitness classes focusing on barre and pilates techniques.

services.name: IV vitamin drips
services.description: Intravenous vitamin therapy administered by medical professionals.

services.name: Infrared sauna
services.description: Access to a small infrared sauna for wellness benefits.

services.name: Cafe
services.description: A publicly accessible cafe offering adaptogenic drinks and bone broth.

targetAudience: Women in their 30s–40s in Bend who care about how they feel but are done with the SoulCycle-adjacent boutique cardio scene.
uniqueSellingPoints: A unique hybrid of boutique fitness classes and comprehensive wellness services.
A dedicated 'third-place' for women in their 30s-40s in Bend.
A minimal, warm, ceramic-studio-feeling aesthetic with natural wood.
An alternative to the prevalent boutique cardio scene, focusing on holistic well-being.
